title: gentiana suborbisepala var. kialensis
intro: Gentiana suborbisepala var. kialensis, commonly known as Kiala gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae) native to China. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its therapeutic properties, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory actions. The bioactive constituents of Kiala gentian include gentiopicroside, gentiacauleine, and loganin, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve appetite, and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders.
